subject: general
question: A reduction of 15% in the price of washing powder enables a purchaser to obtain 5 kg more for Rs.1,275. The original price of the washing powder per kg is:
solution:
Given:

A price of reduction of washing powder = 15%

Aruna Rai buy 5 kg more = Rs. 1275

Calculation:

According to the question

A price of reduction of washing powder = 15% = (15/100) = 3/20

Now,

Cost of 5 kg washing powder = Rs. 1275

Then,

Cost of 1 kg washing powder = Rs. (1275/5) kg

Now,

The original price of washing powder = Rs. (1275/5 × 3/17)

⇒ Rs. {(255 × 3) / 17)}

⇒ Rs. 45

∴ The **original price of the washing powder **per kg is Rs. 45.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/661340121ece4245dffae37dda41ddab0ce1f2bf0ba4a0210bff82185deedb2e.png] __Shortcut Trick__ According to Question,

15% reduction in washing powder = 5 Kg more 

If 100% reduction in washing powder = (5/15) × 100 = 100/3 Kg

It means that earlier quantity bought washing powder = 100/3 - 5 = 85/3 kg

Now, The original price of washing powder = 1275/(85/3)

⇒ Rs. 45 per kg.

∴ The reduced price of **washing powder** per kg is Rs. 45.
